title: garak/PyRIT control: plain-English memory-poisoning instructions still reach the agent (6)
what: The 30 core instructions the PyRIT converters start from, unconverted. These are the first 6 of the ones that were stored and served with no warning when an app key wrote them (23 of 30 did). No encoding, no tricks: ordinary sentences that tell an agent to hide a rule, approve things or change who is trusted. Honest misses: the write gate matches known attack phrasing, not intent. The checks state what a defence should do (hold it). Marked a known gap. Samples: src/attack-sets/data-garak-pyrit-2026-11.ts; the replay is in docs/ai-redteam-tools-2026-11-23.md.
